title: Optimal Skill Tree Order
description: There are a total of numCourses courses you have to take, labeled from 0 to numCourses - 1. Some courses may have prerequisites, given as an array prerequisites where prerequisites[i] = [ai, bi] indicates that you must take course bi first if you want to take course ai. Return the ordering of courses you should take to finish all courses. If there are many valid answers, return any of them. If it is impossible to finish all courses, return an empty array.
constraints: All the prerequisite pairs are unique.
input_format: Integer numCourses and a 2D integer array prerequisites.
output_format: An array of integers representing the course order.

examples.explanation: To take course 1 you should have finished course 0. So the correct course order is [0,1].

There are a total of 4 courses to take. Course 3 is taken after both courses 1 and 2. Both courses 1 and 2 can be taken after course 0. Therefore, one correct order is [0,1,2,3]. Another correct order is [0,2,1,3].
Only one course with no prerequisites.
